verdict.line: You win by poking from 625 range before she can close the gap, and you lose if the trade drags into prolonged exchanges where A Thousand Cuts healing and her on-hit scaling take over.

brief.thesis: Gwen's entire kit is melee — Q (Snip Snip!) is a 450-range cone and E (Skip 'n Slash) is a 400-range dash — while Parrrley hits from 625. That gap lets Gangplank chip her for free until she either lands Skip 'n Slash to flip the fight with on-hit magic damage, or hides behind Hallowed Mist to deny targeting entirely.

theirWindow.when: right after she lands E (Skip 'n Slash)
theirWindow.what: She gains attack speed, range, and magic damage on-hit for a few seconds, and if that hit refunds the dash cooldown she can chain it again almost immediately — disengage rather than trade autos through that window.

yourWindow.when: her W (Hallowed Mist) and E are both down
yourWindow.what: With no gap-closer and no untargetable shell up (22-18s and 13-11s cooldowns respectively), she has zero answer to a 625-range Parrrley — poke freely and don't waste the window.

start.why: 49.5% win rate over 1130 games and the most-picked start (71.9%) — the extra sustain offsets her passive's percent-health poke while you look for free Q trades.

boots.why: 53.7% win rate over 415 games — the lifesteal lets you win prolonged exchanges against her on-hit healing instead of losing the attrition race to A Thousand Cuts.

core.why: Mana sustain to spam Parrrley every 5 seconds without running dry mid-lane.
Lethality turns your poke damage into execute threat before her healing stabilizes the trade.
Highest win rate completion (52.6% over 228 games) — crit scaling snowballs your range advantage into kill pressure.

she or the enemy team starts stacking health to shrug off your burst
you need the shield to survive her Skip 'n Slash all-in window

runes.keystoneWhy: The DoT stacks with Grog-Soaked Blade's poison, so every landed Parrrley bleeds her over time — exactly the kind of sustained poke damage that punishes a melee opponent you outrange.

summoners.why: 92.2% pick rate at 48.4% win rate — Ignite punishes her A Thousand Cuts healing directly and seals kills off your Q poke before she can stabilize the lane.

playing.title: Poke every CS step
playing.detail: Her Q (450 range) and E (400 range) can't touch you at 625 range — punish any forward step she makes to last-hit.

playing.title: Don't Q into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: While her W is active she can't be targeted by anything outside the mist, so Parrrley will simply fail — hold the cast and wait out her 22-18s cooldown instead of wasting charges.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (13-11s cooldown) is her only gap-closer and only damage spike — once it's down she has no way to punish your poke or catch a retreat.

playing.title: Save W for CC, not poke
playing.detail: Remove Scurvy clears crowd control and heals you — hold it for a hard engage or gank, not just to shrug off her passive poison.

playing.title: Use R for siege, not lane kills
playing.detail: Cannon Barrage's 110-120s cooldown is too long to build around a lane kill — save it to zone her off objectives or punish her split-push later.

playing.title: Convert poke into burst
playing.detail: Don't let trades drag — her passive heals off sustained damage, so Collector/IE burst damage followed by Ignite closes out kills before that healing kicks in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner picks are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits, not measured data.
